SEN.note: Geolocation in the property-tax app is mentioned as solving addressing for tax; no address system or register is stated.

facts.fact: Le Soleil reports that the DGID's Pagcf project runs Suigil 2, a web and Android platform to centralise cadastral data and issue tax notices, which after a 2021-2024 pilot added over 38,000 parcels to the tax database in the pilot zones; the Cadastre director says no exhaustive cadastre covers the whole country.

systems.tiers: pilot zones, extension to Dakar region planned

SEN.note: Nothing on connection of local government offices.
The central tax directorate (DGID) assesses and issues property-tax notices; no local government staff recording is stated.
